title: Last night i was in the school. What similar themes do you have in the school?
content: I remembered well this morning so I figure I'd share this mallworld dream in my school area. It started off in the gym with some assembly and I had my backpack with me. It seemed like some movie night or we stayed later than normal cuz it was sunset outside and dark in the gym. I sat on the bleachers with my backpack but kept getting restless so I was moving around a little bit and kept switching seats. Whatever the event was, it wasn't starting soon enough. Inside my backpack was my weed, lighters, money. Stuff I knew I wasn't supposed to have. (I'm always an adult but stuck in the school.) So I am keeping it close but I feel suspicious other people can see my bad stuff in the pockets. I keep moving and suddenly I lost my backpack!!! I'm panicking because all my valuables are in it. As I comb the bleachers and everyone else's backpack I don't see mine. So I decide to go to the office to see if they have it and I'm ready to beg for at *least* my money back. The principal acts useless! He can't help me at all and they don't have the backpack. Its like he doesn't even understand sense of property or authority because he absolutely doesn't care it was stolen. Even the office ladies don't care. So I get more exasperated. I go back to the gym and realize it was this one kid. The people are filing out to the busses and they are about to leave. So I get on busses and try to tell the bus driver don't leave! My backpack is missing. And again, all of them are useless. So useless I woke up feeling bad, lol. And then I check the last bus and he drives off with me inside it but its not my bus, I don't know where its going, and they won't let me off the bus now. So I don't have my money, backpack, or anything, and we are leaving the school to the wilderness and idk where it is.
